notes.title: The Big Update
notes.content:
Hey guys, we are working on a major update for the game it will have a huge change, the game will have a more complex level design, there will be collectibles, some of these collectibles will make the player buy upgrades and items, the 7 levels become 7 themes and each theme 3 levels, which will total 21 stages at the end and new songs for those stages.
I believe that this update will take place near the end of the year.
[previewyoutube=wRWOpZwSIGI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Invulnerability when taking a hit
notes.content:
It was added to the invulnerability mechanics when taking a hit, receives feedback from both you and other people close to our development team who tested the game and asked for this mechanic.
Fixed some bugs, improved translation, tutorial on the first platform.
Nerf na Gladia (she took 4 hearts in her base combo, now takes 3).
You can now change the direction of the strokes between strokes.
